payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP with state (passes, ball holder): dp[i][0] ways Messi has ball, dp[i][1] ways others have ball; recurrence dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][0]*(K-1) + dp[i-1][1]*K, dp[i][1] = dp[i-1][0].
payload.rationale: Solution explicitly builds a 2D DP table where each step depends on two previous states; dp[i][0] and dp[i][1] form a 2-state DP that aligns with 2D state DP (pass index and holder identity).
